    "chain": "Mandalay (from Sanskrit mandala, 'circle' + ay, 'go'); Bay (Old English beag, 'ring' or 'crown')",

    "languages": ["sa", "en", "ang"],

    "languages": ["en"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.7
  },
  {
    "operation": "cross_language_homophone",
    "chain": "Mandalay (Fr. mande-lait, 'asks milk'); Bay (Fr. baie, 'berry')",

    "languages": ["fr", "en"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.5
  },
  {
    "operation": "anagram",
    "chain": "Mandalay Bay -> 'A bland day, may' + 'bay' reversed to 'yab'",

    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.4
  },
  {
    "operation": "notariqon",

    "reading": "Water within the house — a flood of the domestic sphere.",
    "languages": ["he"],
    "source": "Sefer Yetzirah (letter values)",
    "confidence": 0.5
  },
  {
    "operation": "letter_symbol",
    "chain": "M (13th letter) + B (2nd) = 13+2=15; 15 = Yod-Heh, the divine name",
    "reading": "The name of God hidden in the initials — a sacred seal.",
    "languages": ["en", "he"],
    "source": "generative (numerology)",
    "confidence": 0.3
  },
  {
    "operation": "numerical",
    "chain": "Mandalay = 13+1+14+4+1+12+1+25 = 71; Bay = 2+1+25 = 28; 71+28=99",
    "reading": "Ninety-nine — the number of divine attributes in Islamic tradition; a completion.",
    "languages": ["en", "ar"],
    "source": "generative (gematria)",
    "confidence": 0.4
  },
  {
    "operation": "phonetic_split",
    "chain": "Man-da-lay-bay; 'man' + 'da' (Slavic for 'yes') + 'lay' (to place) + 'bay' (laurel)",
    "reading": "Man says yes, places laurel — a victory wreath for the affirmative.",
    "languages": ["en", "ru", "la"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.5
  }
]
